Culture is everywhere — but is it always good? From voodoo and ancestor worship to the Day of the Dead, dragon festivals, and idol rituals, traditions around the world are often defended in the name of “heritage.” But what happens when culture collides with morality?

In this episode of Candid Truth, we expose how culture is not neutral — it has always been used as a tool of influence and control. Ancient empires, secret societies, and even modern governments have weaponized culture to shape beliefs, normalize sin, and pull people into rebellion against truth. From entertainment and fashion to rituals and holidays, culture has been cultivated to form a worldwide mindset.

We’ll dive deep into:
⚔️ How culture has always been tied to cult worship
⚔️ Why traditions like sorcery, divination, and ancestor rituals can’t be excused as “just culture”
⚔️ How entertainment and pop culture normalize rebellion against morality
⚔️ The hidden role of propaganda, symbolism, and social engineering in shaping global culture
⚔️ Why true freedom means stepping out of cultural bondage and choosing a higher standard of right and wrong

This isn’t just about traditions — it’s about the future. As the world pushes for “unity” and “inclusivity,” are we witnessing the rise of a one-world cult system?

👉 Watch now and decide for yourself: Does culture excuse immorality, or is it time we confront the truth?
